text:
oncall-bot: Pager duty alert: high error rate observed on model load/warmup in cluster us-west-2-serving-3. Incident INC-2410 created. Paging on-call.

Alice M: i'm on it — looking at the pod loop restarts. seeing a lot of OOMs during the model warmup step.

Jordan S: confirmed. stack shows CUDA OOM then container crash. model: orca-mini-v2-4b-ptx (custom quant). logs:```
2026-03-15T10:01:58Z loader INFO: starting warmup for model orca-mini-v2-4b-ptx
2026-03-15T10:02:12Z loader ERROR: failed to deserialize weights: EOFError: Unexpected EOF while reading stream
2026-03-15T10:02:13Z runtime ERROR: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.0 GiB (GPU 0; 16.00 GiB total capacity; 13.2 GiB already allocated)
process crashed with exit code 137
```

Tilly (ml): also seeing repeated nvfuser compile timeouts in the same trace — kernels hitting 300s compile deadline and then crash fallback. Might be interaction between deserialization partial read and JIT compile causing memory spike.

Ben R: node-level data — kubelet shows OOMKills then node reboot on host i-0abcd1234. Looks like the pod consumed host memory as well (oom_score). Could be a deserialization bug that maps huge temp buffers.

Infra-run: nodes in us-west-2-serving-3 are flapping: 3/12 nodes showed kernel oom_reaper messages. we're cordoning i-0abcd1234 and draining remaining pods off that node. ETA ~8m to reprovision.

Nadia C: customer impact — support dashboard shows elevated 500s for /v1/generate with errors beginning ~10:02 UTC. Affected customers flagged: acct-A (high qps), acct-B (background job). CS tickets opened: CS-6521, CS-6522. status.redwood.ai set to degraded for "Model loading and generation".

Alice M: quick mitigation: disabling warmup prefetch for that model to avoid heavy memory during load. pushing a config rollback to the model routing policy to use orca-mini-v2-4b-q4 (smaller quant) as a fallback. Doing a canary route to 5% first.

Ben R: please also throttle concurrency for warmup and set env var REDWOOD_WARMUP_MEMORY_LIMIT=6G for the service.

Jordan S: tried restarting a single replica with warmup disabled — it stayed up and served requests to fallback model. 500s dropped for that replica.

Tilly (ml): possible long term fix: add streaming deserialization and checksum checks to fail early on corrupted artifact. also increase compile timeout for nvfuser to 600s for large kernels while we triage.

Infra-run: temporary routing change applied: all traffic for model orca-mini-v2-4b-ptx now routes to fallback pool (q4) and us-east region spillover enabled. commands we ran:```bash
# route traffic away from problematic pool
redwood-cli routing update --model orca-mini-v2-4b-ptx --fallback-model orca-mini-v2-4b-q4 --threshold 0.01
# disable warmup prefetch for group
redwood-cli models update-config --model-group orca-mini --set warmup_prefetch=false
```

Nadia C: notifying affected customers now, CS posting incident notes with mitigation and ETA.

Alice M: collecting heap dumps and the failing artifact binary for further analysis. attaching link to S3: https://s3.redwood.ai/insights/INC-2410/dumps/2410004321.zip

Jordan S: note — there's also a deserialization EOF before the OOM in several traces. that suggests corrupt artifact or truncated download from the cache tier. Re-downloading artifacts on the node and clearing local artifact cache.

Ben R: cache purge command:```bash
# purge local artifact cache on host
ssh ubuntu@i-0abcd1234 'sudo systemctl stop redwood-artifact-cache && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/redwood/artifacts/* && sudo systemctl start redwood-artifact-cache'
```

Tilly (ml): after cache purge and restart, one replica completed warmup successfully (with warmup_prefetch still off). nvfuser compiles still slow but not timing out. good sign.

Infra-run: reprovisioning 2 replacement nodes, adding temporary toleration to schedule fewer heavy warmup replicas per host.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder — on-call rotation change in 2h. Please add a summary before handoff.

Alice M: summary for handoff: root cause suspected artifact corruption + JIT compile memory amplification causing CUDA OOM during warmup. Mitigations applied: route to q4 fallback, disabled warmup prefetch, purged artifact cache on affected nodes, cordoned flaky host, reprovisioned nodes, opened CS tickets. Customer impact: degraded generate endpoint (500s) for 2-3 customers, mitigated for most traffic after fallback routing. Next steps: investigate artifact pipeline, add checksums at publish time, increase compile timeout for large kernels, and add memory cap for warmup.

Nadia C: adding incident note and assigning follow-ups: ENG-2410 (artifact pipeline check), ML-2410 (deserialize hardening), INFRA-2410 (node reprovision and eviction policy).

Jordan S: handing off to night oncall @Ben R — please pick up post-mitigation validation and follow up on artifact publish fixes. I'll leave the heap dumps and traces in the incident folder.

Ben R: acknowledged. I'll monitor for 4h and escalate if error rate rises. leaving a reminder to check status page + CS tickets in 30m. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2410 status updated to "mitigated (ongoing validation)".
